# 3. Functions and variables
## 3.1 Round()
```{r}
round(3.14159, digits = 0)
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```
## 3.2 Seq()
```{r}
print(seq(1, 10, 2))
print(seq(5, 15, 5))
print(seq(by = 2, from = 1, to = 10))
print(seq(by = 5, to = 15, from = 5))
```
## 3.3 Rep()
```{r}
print(rep(5, 7))
print(rep(x = 5, times = 7))
```
# 4 Variables
## 4.1 Assigning variables

```{r}
whatsmynumber <- 1
whatsmynumber <- 5
```
The output will be 5.
```{r}
print(whatsmynumber)
```

## 4.2 Classes
Create character, numerical and logical variables, print them, then check their classes.
```{r}
x <- "charac"
y <- 10.2
z <- TRUE

print(x)
print(class(x))
print(y)
print(class(y))
print(z)
print(class(z))
```

```{r}
# for example
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

n_before_1 <- 5415
n_before_2 <- 8123

n_after_1 <- 1432
n_after_2 <- 7543
```
